nodes.label: Chart: Meta CAPI tracked vs untracked events dashboard, showing Quotes→Orders 20/625 (3.2% conversion), 2 agent quote-bypasses, 19 of 36 CAPI events tracked to Meta vs 17 untracked (missing fbc/fbp/utm, low EMQ), and a 6-month (Dec 2025-Jun 2026) Quote→Order Adoption bar/line chart showing button-based (green) order adoption rising through May 2026 before a June 2026 drop-off, with quotes-created volume peaking in May 2026
Insight: roughly half of Meta CAPI events (17 of 36) go untracked/low Event Match Quality due to missing fbc/fbp/utm parameters, undermining ad tracking accuracy fixed by the related blog post
